nodes.description: Public token ticker string state variable set to 'WC'.
Public token name state variable set to 'WenCoinbase'.
Public 18-decimal precision state variable.
Private total supply, initialised to 1e27 and reduced when tokens are burned.
Constant 100 used by findOnePercent for rounding the amount up.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of holder to spender to approved allowance.
Caller address; credited in constructor and used as the funding/approving party in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
Deployment constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event.
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning balances[holder].
Public view returning allowed[holder][spender].
Private view computing the burn amount: ceil(amount,100)*100/1000, i.e. 10% of the rounded amount.
Transfers amount, burns a 10% fee through findOnePercent and decreases _totalSupply.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = amount and emits Approval.
Spends allowance, moves tokens, burns the 10% fee and reduces both balances[from] and the allowance.
State mutation in transfer: balances[msg.sender], balances[to] and _totalSupply are rewritten after the burn computation.
State mutation in transferFrom: balances[from], balances[to], _totalSupply and allowed[from][msg.sender] are rewritten.
State mutation in approve: allowed[msg.sender][spender] is overwritten with the supplied amount.
holder address parameter of balanceOf.
holder address parameter of allowance.
spender address parameter of allowance.
spender address parameter of approve.
amount parameter of approve, stored verbatim as the allowance.
recipient address parameter of transfer.
amount parameter of transfer, debited from the sender and split into burn and transfer parts.
source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are spent.
recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
amount parameter of transferFrom, debited from from and its allowance.
amount parameter of findOnePercent, rounded up before the fee is derived.
Local roundAmount = amount.ceil(oneHundredPercent) inside findOnePercent.
Local fivePercent = roundAmount*100/1000, the value returned as the burn quantity.
Local in transfer holding findOnePercent(amount), subtracted from _totalSupply.
Local in transfer holding amount - tokensToBurn, credited to the recipient.
Local in transferFrom holding findOnePercent(amount), subtracted from _totalSupply.
Local in transferFrom holding amount - tokensToBurn, credited to the recipient.

edges.reason: oneHundredPercent is read by findOnePercent to round the amount up.
findOnePercent_amount flows into the roundAmount local via ceil().
roundAmount is multiplied and divided to produce the fivePercent burn value.
findOnePercent return value is stored in transfer_tokensToBurn.
transfer_amount determines the burn quantity computed by findOnePercent.
Burned tokens are subtracted from _totalSupply in transfer.
tokensToTransfer = transfer_amount - transfer_tokensToBurn.
transfer_amount is reduced by the burn to obtain the transferred quantity.
tokensToTransfer is added to balances[to] in transfer.
findOnePercent return value is stored in transferFrom_tokensToBurn.
transferFrom_amount determines the burn quantity.
Burned tokens are subtracted from _totalSupply in transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer = transferFrom_amount - transferFrom_tokensToBurn.
transferFrom_amount is reduced by the burn to obtain the transferred quantity.
tokensToTransfer is added to balances[to] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is credited with the initial supply in constructor and its balance is debited in transfer/transferFrom.
msg.sender is the outer key of the allowed mapping written in approve and read/cleared in transferFrom.
transfer debits the balance of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance under msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance granted by msg.sender.
balances[from] is debited by transferFrom_amount.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is read and decreased in transferFrom.
balances[to] is credited in transferFrom.
balances[to] is credited in transfer.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns balances[holder].
allowance returns allowed[holder][spender].
holder parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
holder parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowance written by approve.
approve_amount is stored directly as the allowance value.
transfer performs the balances/_totalSupply state mutation.
transferFrom performs the balances/_totalSupply/allowance state mutation.
approve performs the allowance state write.
transfer calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
transferFrom calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.

normalization_plan.reason: holder is only used to index balances inside balanceOf and carries no independent semantics.
holder is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender only selects the inner key of the allowance written by approve.
approve_amount is written verbatim into allowed and is fully described by approve's state write.
to is only the recipient key of balances credited by transfer.
transfer_amount drives the burn and the transfer arithmetic inside transfer.
from is only the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
to is only the credited recipient in transferFrom.
transferFrom_amount drives the burn, transfer and allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
amount is the sole input of the burn-fee computation.
roundAmount is an intermediate value fully contained in findOnePercent.
fivePercent is the return value of findOnePercent and is captured by its caller.
tokensToBurn is the burn quantity subtracted from _totalSupply and balance inside transfer.
tokensToTransfer is the net amount credited to the recipient inside transfer.
tokensToBurn is the burn quantity subtracted from _totalSupply inside transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer is the net amount credited to the recipient inside transferFrom.
